subject: radiology
title: Cobalt 60, Linear Accelerators, IMRT and Proton Bragg Peak

steps.title: Cobalt 60 decays on a clock
steps.tx: **Cobalt 60 teletherapy** beams gamma rays of 1.17 and 1.33 megaelectronvolts, averaging 1.25, from a decaying source with a half life of 5.27 years. Output falls about one percent a month, stretching treatment times until the source is replaced roughly every five to seven years. Its wide penumbra from a large source and constant decay made it the developing worlds workhorse before linear accelerators spread.
steps.say: Cobalt 60 teletherapy beams gamma rays averaging one point two five megaelectronvolts from a source with half life five point two seven years. Output falls about one percent a month until replacement every five to seven years. Its wide penumbra made it the workhorse before linear accelerators spread.

steps.tx: **Cobalt 60 teletherapy** emits gamma rays of 1.17 and 1.33 megaelectronvolts, an average of 1.25, from a source whose half life is 5.27 years. Output falls by about one percent each month, so treatment times stretch until the source is replaced, roughly every 5 to 7 years. The physical source is large, and the penumbra is wide. Steady decay plus that penumbra made the unit a workhorse in many services before linear accelerators became widely available.
steps.say: A cobalt 60 unit emits gamma rays that average 1.25 megaelectronvolts. The half life is 5.27 years, and output falls about one percent each month until the source is changed at about 5 to 7 years. The large source casts a wide penumbra, a reason linear accelerators later replaced most units.

steps.title: Skin sparing and build up
steps.tx: **Skin sparing effect** of megavoltage beams deposits maximum dose below the skin, at depth 0.5 cm for cobalt 60 and about 1.5 cm for a 6 megavolt beam, because secondary electrons need distance to build up. Skin therefore tolerates megavoltage courses that orthovoltage beams would burn. Bolus material on the skin deliberately destroys that sparing when the target is skin itself, as in chest wall recurrence cover.
steps.say: Skin sparing effect deposits maximum dose below skin, half a centimetre for cobalt and about one point five centimetres for a six megavolt beam. Skin tolerates megavoltage courses orthovoltage beams would burn. Bolus on the skin deliberately destroys that sparing when the target is skin itself.

steps.title: Linear accelerator makes both beams
steps.tx: **Linear accelerator** fires electrons at a tungsten target to brew megavoltage photons, or removes the target and treats with the electron beam itself. Electrons stop within centimetres, dose set by energy at roughly one third of energy in centimetres depth, ideal for skin, scar boosts and chest wall. Photons penetrate to deep pelvis and chest targets. One machine therefore covers superficial and deep work by switching modes.
steps.say: Linear accelerator fires electrons at a tungsten target to brew photons, or removes the target and treats with electrons themselves. Electrons stop within centimetres, ideal for skin and scar boosts. Photons penetrate to deep targets. One machine covers superficial and deep work by switching modes.

steps.title: 3D conformal to IMRT
steps.tx: **IMRT**, intensity modulated radiotherapy, lets each beam deliver a patterned fluence through moving multileaf collimator leaves, sculpting concave dose around cord and parotids that 3D conformal blocks cannot carve. The price is a larger bath of low dose through normal tissue and heavy planning physics. Image guided radiotherapy then verifies position daily with cone beam CT, cashing the conformity IMRT promises instead of assuming the setup repeats perfectly.

Image guidance verifies position daily, cashing the conformity IMRT promises instead of assuming perfect setup.

steps.title: Stereotactic and gamma knife
steps.tx: **Stereotactic radiosurgery** delivers one large precise fraction, gamma knife pooling about two hundred cobalt sources through a frame onto intracranial targets like metastases, acoustic neuromas and arteriovenous malformations. Frame or frameless body stereotaxis extends the idea to lung and spine in three to five fractions. Precision, not energy, is the product: submillimetre targeting buys the right to use ablative doses beside cord and optic structures.

Body stereotaxis extends the idea to lung and spine in three to five fractions. Precision buys the right to use ablative doses beside cord and optic structures.

steps.title: Proton Bragg peak stops
steps.tx: **Bragg peak** is the dose spike protons deposit at the end of their range before stopping completely, with almost no exit dose beyond the tumour. Depth is dialled by beam energy, and multiple energies stack peaks into a spread out plateau covering the target. Children and skull base tumours gain most, sparing growing tissue and the brain beyond, at several times photon cost and with range uncertainty margins that planning must respect.

steps.title: Total body irradiation
steps.tx: **Total body irradiation** conditions marrow before transplant, using large fields, extended distance, lung shielding blocks and low dose rates to deliver a myeloablative but survivable whole body dose in fractions. The lungs cap the prescription because radiation pneumonitis is the dose limiting toxicity, with kidneys and lens following. It survives in leukaemia conditioning because no drug reaches sanctuary sites like testis and brain as evenly as photons do.
steps.say: Total body irradiation conditions marrow before transplant, using large fields and lung shielding to deliver a survivable whole body dose. The lungs cap the prescription because pneumonitis is the dose limiting toxicity. It survives because no drug reaches sanctuary sites as evenly as photons.

steps.title: Choosing energy at the desk
steps.tx: **Beam choice** questions in examinations reduce to depth, skin and exit: superficial targets take electrons or superficial photons, deep pelvic targets take high energy photons, spinal cord behind the target argues for protons or IMRT carving, and skin involvement erases skin sparing with bolus. Cobalt answers now test its decay arithmetic and gamma knife role more than routine planning, reflecting its shrinking but real global footprint.
